notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK). CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026; Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. Both the 13F (September 30, 2026) and the Q3 FY2027 10-Q cover count (November 19, 2026) are after the four-for-one stock split effected July 1, 2026; the cover count is the same one used in the marketcap lens. Holders of record: Class A; no Class B holders.
